name: Drums & croakers
description: Drums and croakers - the sciaenid family: Pseudotolithus croakers (adults and juveniles measured as separate stanzas by the source) plus the Sciaena and Umbrina group. Functional group pooling the source's croakers-adult, croakers-juvenile and scianids compartments - one sciaenid guild clicking and drumming over the seafloor, eating large crustaceans and small fish; pooled to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling.
